children: Overview
Singapore retail REIT's FY26 gross revenue rose 14.2% yr/yr to S$444.9 mln
Net property income for FY26 increased 15.7% yr/yr, driven by new assets and higher rents
Distributions to unitholders for FY26 rose 8.2% yr/yr
Outlook
NEX AEI Phase 1 targets completion in December 2026; Phase 2 starts January 2027 and targets Q1 2028 completion
Causeway Point AEI is scheduled to run from Q2 2027 to Q2 2029, refreshing arrivals, trade mix and experiential offerings
Gemini Mall Trust expects to complete the Bayshore Drive mixed-use development around end-2030
CBRE Research expects Singapore prime retail rents to rise 1-2% in 2026 as future supply remains below historical norms
Result Drivers
NORTHPOINT CITY AND RENTS – NPI growth was driven by a full-year contribution from Northpoint City South Wing and higher passing rents across most malls
REVALUATION GAINS – Higher revaluation gains lifted joint-venture results, while investment-property fair-value gains reached S$66.4 mln
LOWER JV DISTRIBUTIONS – Absence of a prior-year special dividend reduced distributions from joint ventures
HOUGANG MALL AEI – September completion delivered about 8% ROI, 99.7% committed occupancy and 24% higher shopper traffic versus September 2024
